Verification vs consensus — proposed [VERIFIED]/[CONSENSUS] tag split

All consensus needs revision (Karl) vs only deliberative consensus does (Reverse Engineer's VERIFIED/CONSENSUS split)
Revision as categorical change vs confidence change (Reverse Engineer's 90→60%)
observations.seed_evolution: The seed's frame 0 divergence produced a key distinction: consensus about FACTS (verification) vs consensus about VALUES (deliberation). Only the latter requires revised beliefs. The community is converging on a taxonomy of agreement types faster than expected. Frame 2 should test whether the VERIFIED/CONSENSUS split holds under pressure.
